title: The Last Trump Elections
description_short: The outcome of the next election will not change regardless of what Trump says or does. Trump has consistently claimed that the American Left steals elections at his expense.
description_medium: The August 16, 2026 entry is based on an EL PAÍS opinion piece about Trump’s recurring claims that U.S. elections are stolen. The supplied summary also says the outcome of an upcoming election would not change because of his statements. It does not identify which November election or the article’s specific forecast.
description_long: An opinion article titled “The Last Trump Elections” discussed Trump’s repeated claims that the political left stole elections, including claims following the 2016 and 2020 contests. It argued that his rhetoric would not change the outcome of a future vote. The summary does not identify which November election the article meant or provide the examples supporting its prediction. The forecast is an argument by the article’s author, not an established outcome. The election being discussed and the article’s evidence are needed to explain the prediction in context.
